<!-- pr-reviewer: c0860ac3b73bef98c94f89033ae815e1252d61cc -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The review found no blocking changes.

- All 44 operation sections use the app's icon mapping. The tests check all 93 copied PNG files and the full license notice against the app files.
- The icon component preserves the site path prefix. The footer links to the license notice. The CSS sets icon size and dark mode color.
- The change meets issue #1901. It changes no Rust crate, posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision or gouge check. No golden files changed.

Local results with upstream/main at `31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239`:

- Trial merge: clean; the PR already contains this main commit.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -v`: 19 passed, 0 failed. This includes the rendered icon and license link checks with a site path prefix.
- Zola 0.23.6: `zola build --output-dir /tmp/review-2080-site` passed from `site`; 43 pages and 10 sections.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed; zero Rust steps selected.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; zero failed steps.
- Rust crate tests and clippy: not applicable; no crate changed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`: passed.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: No mutation tests were run in this review. The change is outside the safety tier. The review did not include a browser visual check or a Windows build. No `crates/ui` UI files changed, so the UI screenshot rule does not apply.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
